findings.observation: The checker omits or under-parses required exact-file-set, header metadata, exclusive REQ-028 ownership, Stale exclusion, reference-style link, unique portfolio-row, immutable Review-result/ChangeRecord and cleared-staleness validations.

findings.impact: The checker returns exit 0, overall PASS and all 13 checks PASS for content that violates the approved governance contract, allowing a valid-looking digest and envelope to falsely authorize invalid plan state.

evidence.description: Implementation-plan lines 247-264 and 289-307 require these semantic gates; design lines 162-176 require TargetDate and RequirementsBaseline metadata.
A committed fixture removing TargetDate and RequirementsBaseline from IP-04 still returned exit 0, overall PASS and 13/13 PASS.
An independent pass committed nine separate contract-invalid fixtures; every fixture returned exit 0 and all checks PASS.
The supplied negative harness covers the cycle-one cases but does not exercise any of the remaining mandatory paths.
